# e2b_team_metric_max (Data Source)

Reads the maximum E2B team metric value for an interval. E2B exposes team metrics as read-only telemetry and does not expose metric creation through the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_team_metric_max" "concurrent_sandboxes" {
  team_id = "team_123"
  metric  = "concurrent_sandboxes"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metric` (String) Metric to evaluate. E2B supports `concurrent_sandboxes` and `sandbox_start_rate`.
- `team_id` (String) E2B team ID.

### Optional

- `end` (Number) Optional Unix timestamp for the end of the interval, in seconds.
- `start` (Number) Optional Unix timestamp for the start of the interval, in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `timestamp` (String) Deprecated RFC3339 timestamp returned by E2B.
- `timestamp_unix` (Number) Unix timestamp for the max metric point.
- `value` (Number) Maximum metric value.
